title: Dividend Scale Band Table: Election Withdrawal Interest Rate on Large Whole Life Insurance Accumulation Deposits
content:
**Whole Life Insurance — interest on accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election.**

The interest rate on accumulations withdrawn at an election is the declared accumulation rate raised for a large deposit. The size of the deposit is judged by the deposit as the policy ledger totals it, that is the dividends placed on deposit plus the interest credited less the withdrawals, as the dividend deposit, interest credit and accumulation withdrawal entries on the activity history total them.

| Ledger-totalled deposit (USD) | Rate raised by |
|---|---|
| 25000 or more | 0.50 percentage point (0.005) |
| 10000 or more, below 25000 | 0.25 percentage point (0.0025) |
| Below 10000 | Not raised |

The increase is added to the rate in percentage points; it is not a multiple of the rate.

## Band edges (hypothetical deposits, declared rate 3.75%)

| Deposit entries total | Interest credits total | Withdrawals total | Ledger deposit | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22000.00 | 3000.00 | 0.00 | 25000.00 | 4.25% |
| 22000.00 | 3000.00 | 0.01 | 24999.99 | 4.00% |
| 9000.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 | 10000.00 | 4.00% |
| 9000.00 | 999.99 | 0.00 | 9999.99 | 3.75% |

The band is read from the ledger totals, which may differ from the balance shown on the policy record.
